scope: Fixed roster of 123 unique method x dataset pairs, 20 methods and 7 datasets; not the full package Cartesian product.
unit: Equal weight per unique method x dataset pair; average all declared matched rates within a pair.
threshold_rule: strict <; policy credits are included in overall counts and are never converted to measured gaps

policy_credits.rule: All declared rates completed; count these 7 NR-reference pairs toward each threshold. Their numerical gaps remain null.

exclusions: GEOM and SFGC published-only values, whole-graph baselines, no-reference extra cells, and other methods outside the declared roster are excluded.
protocol_scope: Cumulative frozen reruns with method-specific provenance replay, validation-selected HPO, and historical baselines; not a single uniform new run of the current checkout. Per-pair evaluation_profile identifies adopted reruns; historical_frozen denotes inherited results.

reference_corrections.rule: Where GC4NC v3 main-text Table 1 and Appendix Table 9 disagree, Table 1 is authoritative; the Table 9 Pubmed 0.02% K-Center cell (79.18) is a transcription error and belongs to TSpanner (absent from Table 1).
